title: Need Help: Libre2 - Patched LibreLink - Moto 360 3rd Gen
body:
I have worked through the documentation and thought I did everything right: uninstalled LibreLink, installed the patched version, then xDrip+; started a new sensor with patched LibreLink, started new sensor in xDrip, data source in xDrip is LibreLink (patched). In LibreLink, all alarms are set. Before wondering about the Moto not getting any data - the problem probably still lies with the data collection on the phone. The status says: last data 1.1.1970 (so never) and an empty value. Log repeatedly says: "repeatedly restarting collector service due to lack of reception: backoff: 120"

LibreLink repeatedly sends a "connection lost" alarm. Scanning the sensor with the LibreLink app works. 

Actually it looks like the alarms in LibreLink are not available at all and it is not connected to the sensor by BT. The sensor appears in the "available devices" list on the phone as well as on the watch as ABBOTT..... but is not connected and does not connect when manually activated. 

Is it possible starting the sensor with the patched app did not turn out the right way?

comments.body: I am pretty sure, I have no alarms at all now with the patched LibreLink. Something went wrong when starting the sensor with it.

I sacrificed one sensor and started over - now it works, even with the data in the watchface-complication. Maybe sth. went wrong with the app-permissions of the LibreLink, since it did not ask for those permissions. 2nd time I went into the settings regardless and gave permission for files and location...
